94592.overview: Magic Crayons intends to help the children to learn basic geometrical figures, colors and dexterity while coloring black&white scenes with the sensitive pen of the Pico system, placing geometrical forms, creating toys from different parts (choosing body, ears, eyes, etc...). A basic animation studio kit allows kids to create short cartoons.

147104.overview: Licca-chan ni Naritai! (リカちゃんになりたい！) is a 2001 Sega Pico game based on the Licca-chan series of dolls.

147161.overview:
LEGO Fun to Build is a puzzle game title where each of the levels are based on LEGO themes of the time, including Town, Aquazone, Castle, and Space . The game also features a free build mode in which the player can use common LEGO pieces to build their own model, as well as draw on a snapshot of the completed project.

The building puzzles show an order of steps to follow to complete building different LEGO models. The order is demonstrated opposite of how it should be assembled, and the player must choose among the 6 parts which to add next to complete the model. A score will be shown for how many seconds it took to build the model. The lower the score, the better the record.

Most of the building puzzles are followed by minigames, ranging from racing to hockey.

147176.overview: Take a magical journey through time with Mickey as he meets great inventors in history. Your children will learn about the calendar, how to tell time and about amazing inventions created by Leonardo Da Vinci, Thomas Edison and the Wright Brothers. Using characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartons!

147222.overview:
Disney's The Lion King: Adventures at Pride Rock is based on the 1994 Disney animated film. It offers several activities in Simba's universe:
Use memory skills to create a picture with puzzle pieces.
Uncover a picture and learn your ABC.
Match and learn shapes and put them in their place.
Count stars in the sky and learn numbers.
Develop your dexterity in an easy arcade mini-game
